production_changes.reason: Explicit detection rules for MISSING_GEOMETRIC_VALIDATION and MISSING_MODALITY to guarantee 100% gap detection coverage
production_changes.behavioral_impact: Identifies unvalidated initial candidates and missing auxiliary spectral channels cleanly

limitations: No independently validated real OHRC/TMC-2 tie-point ground truth exists; real-data accuracy is strictly N/A.
Real physical correspondence remains not validated due to 1.5 - 2.1 km physical swath separation.
Additional sensor modalities (IIRS, LROC NAC, SELENE TC) remain unavailable locally.
Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate controlled algorithmic robustness but cannot substitute for real-lunar verification.
Empirical probabilistic calibration (e.g. ECE) on real lunar data remains unestablished.
Geometric uncertainty saturation occurs above 4.0 px reprojection error.
Active-loop belief confirmation (SUPPORTED to CONFIRMED) was demonstrated using synthetic follow-up altimetry.
Full spacecraft orbital mechanics, attitude jitter, and mission scheduling constraints are not simulated.

claims.claim: Under the tested synthetic parameter range, scale normalization changed correspondence recovery.
The evaluated real OHRC/TMC-2 candidates were rejected by the physical validation pipeline under tested conditions.
The world model maintained non-transitive entity associations under evaluated controlled scenarios.
Observed optical parallax displacement scales linearly with terrain relief at 88.96m per 1000m relief for TMC-2 wing.
Real-data correspondence accuracy is universally established.
LunarSynapse is universally scale and illumination invariant.
